senses.definition: (often childish) Dad, daddy, father; a familiar or old-fashioned term of address to one’s father.
(informal) A pet name for one's grandfather.
A parish priest in the Greek Orthodox Church.

quotes.text: they are all of the Orthodox Church, and obey devoutly the precepts of Papa Athanasius
